summary: System administrator with hands-on experience deploying and maintaining server infrastructure. I configure Linux servers, web servers and reverse proxies, DNS, directory services and databases, and ensure monitoring, backups and security. I run services in Docker, automate routine tasks with scripts, and build CI/CD. I combine administration with development in C# and Python, so I quickly understand application services and write tooling for them.

bullets: Deployed and maintain a production VK Mini Apps backend on Ubuntu Server: nginx, systemd service, HTTPS via Let's Encrypt, auto-deploy
Configured local DNS (BIND9), centralized OpenLDAP authentication and network policies
Set up a Docker service stack (Portainer, File Browser, Home Assistant, Navidrome, Gitea) behind a Caddy reverse proxy
Organized Zabbix monitoring, journald logging and backups
Automated routine operations with Bash, PowerShell and Python scripts
Deployed a Gitea Git server on Ubuntu Server with repository, user and access-right management
Configured MySQL: database and service accounts, privilege grants
Set up Nginx as a reverse proxy and BIND9 with forward and reverse DNS zones
Configured OpenLDAP for centralized authentication with user import via LDIF
Ensured security: SSH, UFW, GPG commit signing, secret-leak scanning, operation audit
Deployed services on Oracle VirtualBox and configured systemd units for autostart
Designed relational databases end to end: from an ER model to implementation in a DBMS
Wrote analytical T-SQL queries: JOIN, GROUP BY / HAVING, subqueries, EXISTS, PIVOT
Managed DBMS user accounts and privileges
Worked with MySQL Workbench (forward engineering, export/import) and MS Access (tables, forms, reports)
Develop and maintain Telegram bots and backend services deployed via systemd
Set up automated service deployment through GitHub Actions and dedicated deploy keys
Built remote PC administration utilities: Wake-on-LAN and SSH launch
